title: A Family Visit and a Shopping List
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方雅思测试）。请先阅读短文，注意 we/they、are、规则复数、my/your/his/her、have/has 的用法。然后完成8道阅读题和8道语法题。阅读题答案必须来自原文；填空题答案必须与原文完全一致。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。
passage:
A. My name is Lily. Today my family is at my home. We are happy. My mother and father are here. They are from Shanghai. My brother Tom is ten. My sister Anna is six. We have a small white dog, Coco.

B. My mother has a shopping list on the table. We need apples, eggs, milk, and bread. My father has a big bag. Tom and Anna are ready at the door. We are eight people today.

C. Now we are at the shop. It is small. We have two bags. My mother has the list. My father has the money. Tom has a red apple. Anna has a blue pen. I have a green book. We are happy.

questions.explanation: 原文第一段第一句说 'Today my family is at my home.'，所以今天家人在家。
questions.evidence: Today my family is at my home.

questions.explanation: 原文说 'My brother Tom is ten.'，Tom十岁。
原文说 'We have a small white dog, Coco.'，狗的名字是Coco。
questions.evidence: We have a small white dog, Coco.

questions.explanation: 原文说 'My mother has a shopping list on the table.'，桌子上是购物清单。
questions.evidence: My mother has a shopping list on the table.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: We need apples, eggs, milk, and ______.
questions.explanation: 原文列出 'apples, eggs, milk, and bread'，所以填 bread。
questions.evidence: We need apples, eggs, milk, and bread.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: My father has the ______.
questions.explanation: 原文说 'My father has the money.'，所以填 money。

questions.prompt: According to passage B, how many people are there today?
questions.explanation: 原文B段说 'We are eight people today.'，所以今天有八个人。
原文说 'Anna has a blue pen.'，Anna有一支蓝色钢笔。

grammar.title: we / they + are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation: 本课新规则：1) 主语是 we（我们）或 they（他们/她们/它们）时，be动词用 are。例如：We are happy. They are here. 2) 规则复数：名词后加 -s 表示多个，如 apples, eggs, bags。3) 形容词性物主代词：my（我的）、your（你的/你们的）、his（他的）、her（她的），后面必须接名词，如 my mother, his name, her bag。4) have / has 表示“有”：I/you/we/they 用 have；he/she/it 用 has。例如：We have a dog. She has a pen. 注意：his 和 her 根据拥有者性别选择，不根据物品。
grammar.example: We are happy. My mother has a shopping list. Tom has a red apple.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We ______ happy today.
questions.explanation: 主语是 we，be动词用 are。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: They ______ at the door.
questions.explanation: 主语是 they，be动词用 are。
questions.evidence: Tom and Anna are ready at the door.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct plural: one apple, two ______.
questions.explanation: 规则复数在名词后加 -s，apple → apples。
questions.evidence: We need apples, eggs, milk, and bread.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: This is Tom. ______ name is Tom.
questions.explanation: Tom 是男性，他的 name 用 his。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: This is Anna. ______ bag is blue.
questions.explanation: Anna 是女性，她的 bag 用 her。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: She ______ a red pen.
questions.explanation: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，用 has。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We ______ two bags.
Choose the correct word: My father ______ the money.
questions.explanation: 主语 my father 是第三人称单数，用 has。
